title: Your paper, ready for your slides.
description: Browse equations as a visual library. Select one—or a whole group—and drag them into your presentation.
alt: FerMatter Library showing equations from the synthetic trajectory paper.

title: A thought. An equation. A slide.
description: Open Instant, type LaTeX or Typst, and take the result with you. Open it from a project to reuse its commands and packages.
alt: Instant editor with editable mathematics and its rendered preview.

title: Keep the context close.
description: Move between the paper PDF and its source. A file tree, outline, completion, formatting, and split editors keep larger projects manageable.
alt: Source editor beside the compiled synthetic paper PDF.

title: More than equations.
description: Bring TikZ and CeTZ diagrams along, too. Export vector artwork that stays sharp as you arrange and resize your slides.
alt: Synthetic CeTZ triangle and workflow diagrams in the Library.
